_meta.name: resume-machine
_meta.description: Standalone local application that ingests HTML job postings, correlates them against a personal skills index, and produces tailored resume PDFs — all driven through a browser-based UX served locally. No cloud dependency. No JSON Resume toolchain required at runtime. No Node.js dependency.

permanent_decisions.rationale: HTML job postings are static. BeautifulSoup4 + lxml handles all parsing without browser automation. Eliminates the only non-Python runtime, the cross-process ingest call, and the node_modules dependency surface.

permanent_decisions.decision: Cover letter stored in a separate file from the correlation JSON
permanent_decisions.rationale: Cover letter content is operator-edited (volatile lifecycle); correlation facets are auto-generated (derived lifecycle). Separating them means the correlator can always overwrite its own output without risking manual edits. Eliminates the --force flag and the skip-if-present preservation logic.

permanent_decisions.decision: UX navigation: year (defaulted to current) + optional month filter + keyword text search. Month does not gate search.
permanent_decisions.rationale: Operators know the employer or job title, not necessarily the processing date. All jobs for the current year are discoverable by default. Month is a refinement, not a prerequisite. Keyword filtering is client-side over allJobs[]. Eliminates the cascading day-select and two round-trips.

permanent_decisions.decision: skills-index.json uses v2.3.0 facet_catalog format (operator decision C). The original intent of a flat skill array is superseded.
permanent_decisions.rationale: The pre-existing skills-index.json uses a rich v2.3.0 faceted schema. Rewriting it as a flat array would destroy structured data including confidence_level, last_used, and experience_level. The correlator adapts via _build_facet_lookup() instead.
permanent_decisions.superseded_note: Original intent was a simple flat array of skill objects per an earlier design pass. That intent is not implemented. See data_schemas.skills_index_schema for the canonical format and _build_facet_lookup() for the adapter contract.

permanent_decisions.decision: Deterministic pipeline — no agent graph, no operability section
permanent_decisions.rationale: All stages are scripted, sequential, and stateless between runs. Agent orchestration adds no value. Operational commands belong in the README.

python.choice: Python 3.10+ for all processing scripts and the UX server

job_json_schema.description: Output of extraction stage. One file per job posting. Co-located with source HTML.

required_fields.job_title: String. Title of the job position.
required_fields.job_posting.required_skills: Array of strings. Skills explicitly marked as required.
required_fields.job_posting.additional_skills: Array of strings. Nice-to-have or preferred skills.
required_fields.job_posting.responsibilities: Array of strings. Key responsibilities and duties.
required_fields.job_posting.overview: String. 1-2 sentence summary of the role.
required_fields.job_posting.specialization: String. Domain hint extracted from the HTML if present (e.g., 'backend', 'devops'). Not written or mutated by the correlator. The canonical domain for a processed job lives in correlation.domain.

correlation_json_schema.description: Canonical per-job record containing facet correlations, domain inference, and highlights. Co-located with source job JSON. Does NOT contain the cover letter — that lives in the companion letter JSON. Always overwritten on re-correlation. Manually editable post-generation.

metadata.candidate_name: String. Candidate name as it appears in the output filename. Populated from config.yaml candidate_name or --name flag override. Included in /api/correlation response so the client can construct document.title without parsing the file path.
metadata.generated_at: String. ISO 8601 UTC timestamp. Use datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() — datetime.utcnow() is deprecated in Python 3.12.
metadata.job_json: String. Absolute path to the source job JSON file.
metadata.skills_index: String. Absolute path to the skills-index.json used during this correlation.

summary.total_correlations: Integer. Count of all matched facets.
summary.hard_gaps_count: Integer. Count of HARD_GAP terms. Derivable from correlations[]; stored for human readability. See td-001.
summary.tag_distribution: Object. Map of tag → count. Derivable from correlations[]; stored for human readability. See td-001.

required_fields.correlations: Array of objects. Each: { term (string), type (string: facet_type category from role template e.g. 'language', 'framework'), tag (one of the six tags defined in tag_taxonomy), notes (string) }
required_fields.hard_gaps: Array of objects. Each: { term (string), context (string: 'required_skills' or 'additional_skills') }. Derivable from correlations[]; stored for human readability.
required_fields.domain: String. Inferred by adapter. One of: devops | backend | frontend | fullstack | manager | ai | database.
required_fields.featured_languages: Array of strings. Primary languages/platforms matched from role template keywords.
required_fields.highlights: Array of plain-text strings (max 6). Domain-matched highlights from role template. Top 3 rendered in the resume summary panel. No HTML.

tag_taxonomy.LEAD_STRENGTH: Term in required_skills; facet_lookup match with experience_level 'advanced' or 'expert' (or proficiency 'expert').
tag_taxonomy.SOLID_MATCH: Term in required_skills; facet_lookup match with experience_level 'intermediate' (or proficiency 'intermediate'/'proficient').
tag_taxonomy.UNTESTED_CLAIM: Term in required_skills; facet_lookup match with experience_level 'beginner' or proficiency 'novice'/'beginner' — OR any proficiency level where the staleness_rule fires (last_used > 24 months before correlation run date).
tag_taxonomy.PARTIAL_MATCH: Term in additional_skills (non-required); facet_lookup match at any proficiency.
tag_taxonomy.GAP_ADJACENCY: Term in required_skills or additional_skills; no facet_lookup match, but the term appears as a keyword in at least one role template file. Signals domain-adjacent vocabulary the candidate works near but has not formally indexed.
tag_taxonomy.HARD_GAP: Term in required_skills; no facet_lookup match AND the term does not appear in any role template keywords. Genuine skill gap requiring direct attention.
tag_taxonomy.staleness_rule: If a facet_lookup match exists but facet_entry.last_used is more than 24 months before the correlation run date, the tag is UNTESTED_CLAIM regardless of proficiency. Referenced by name in sprint tasks.
tag_taxonomy._note: additional_skills terms that match no facet and no role template keyword are silently excluded from correlations[]. They are not tagged HARD_GAP — HARD_GAP is reserved for required_skills terms only.

cover_letter_json_schema.description: Operator-editable cover letter content. Stored separately from the correlation JSON so re-correlation never overwrites manual edits. Generated once at first correlation run; never touched again unless absent.

required_fields.opening: String. Must reference both job_title and employer. Construction rule: 'Dear Hiring Team at {employer}, I am writing to apply for the {job_title} position.'
required_fields.value_proposition: String. 2-3 sentences. Construction rule: join the notes fields of the first two LEAD_STRENGTH correlations as declarative sentences. If fewer than two LEAD_STRENGTH entries exist, fall back to highlights[0] and highlights[1] joined as sentences. NOTE: auto-generated content is a starting point; the operator is expected to edit this field in the letter JSON before printing.
required_fields.relevant_experience: Array of strings (max 5). Sourced from highlights[0..4]. One string per entry.
required_fields.closing: String. Construction rule: 'I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience contributes to {employer}'s goals. Thank you for your consideration.'

cover_letter_json_schema.generation_rule: Written once when the correlation JSON is first generated. Never overwritten by subsequent correlator runs. Operator edits this file directly to refine content. Regenerated if absent.

role_template_schema.description: Single file per job domain. Single source of truth consumed by the adapter at runtime.

required_fields.domain: String. Must match filename stem exactly and be one of known_domains.
required_fields.keywords: Array of strings. Terms from job postings indicating this domain. Used for domain scoring and GAP_ADJACENCY detection.
required_fields.facet_types: Array of strings. Skill and concept CATEGORIES that appear in this domain. These are category labels — NOT tag taxonomy labels. e.g. ['language', 'framework', 'practice', 'tool', 'platform', 'cloud_provider']. Used to label the 'type' field of each correlation entry.
required_fields.highlights: Array of 6+ plain-text strings. Domain-specific candidate strengths. Sourced into correlation.highlights[]. No HTML. No markdown. No bracketed placeholders.

skills_index_schema.description: Personal skill catalog: data/skills-index.json. Faceted normalized format v2.3.0. The correlator reads from facet_catalog only via _build_facet_lookup(). Manually maintained.
skills_index_schema.structure: Object with top-level keys: @context, $schema, metadata, venues_catalog, skills_catalog, facet_catalog, skills. The correlator reads from facet_catalog only.

facet_catalog.description: Array of facet entries. The only section the correlator reads at runtime.

facet_entry_format.facet_name: String. Display name used for matching. e.g. 'Python', 'SQL/MySQL'.
facet_entry_format.facet_type: String. One of: hands_on_language | hands_on_framework | hands_on_tool | hands_on_platform | hands_on_skill | strategic_domain | leadership_soft_skill.
facet_entry_format.proficiency: String. One of: novice | beginner | intermediate | advanced | expert.
facet_entry_format.confidence_level: Integer 1–10. Enriched from skills[] entries by _build_facet_lookup().
facet_entry_format.last_used: String. ISO date or YYYY-MM. STALENESS RULE (named 'staleness_rule' for sprint reference): if this date is more than 24 months before the correlation run date, the facet produces UNTESTED_CLAIM regardless of proficiency.
facet_entry_format.experience_level: String. Optional. One of: beginner | intermediate | advanced | expert.

skills_index_schema.correlator_adapter: _build_facet_lookup(skills_index: dict) → dict[str, dict]: iterates facet_catalog to build a lookup keyed by lowercase facet_name; enriches each entry with proficiency, confidence_level, years_of_experience, last_used, and experience_level from the skills[] array. Returns the enriched lookup. This is the only interface between the correlator and skills-index.json.

facet_type_weights._note: Currently metadata-only. Not used in correlation scoring or tag assignment. See td-002 for the option to apply these as a weighted match score.

resume_source_schema.description: Base candidate data. Served as /api/resume. Consumed by resume-machine.html to populate the resume section.

basics.name: String. Full name.
basics.location: String or object: { address, postalCode, city, countryCode }.

required_sections.work: Array of { company, position, startDate (YYYY-MM-DD), endDate (YYYY-MM-DD or null if current), summary }. Reverse chronological.
required_sections.education: Array of { institution, studyType, area, startDate (optional), endDate (optional) }.
required_sections.skills: Array of { name, level (optional), keywords (optional array) }.

architecture_diagram._comment: Top-to-bottom pipeline. Each stage has one canonical input and one canonical output.

stages.name: Ingest
stages.script: src/data/py_extract_jobs.py — pure Python, invoked as module. No Node.js.
stages.output: One job JSON per posting at data/jobbankjobs/{year}/{month:02d}/{day:02d}/{slug}.json. job_posting.specialization is populated from the HTML if present; the correlator does not write back to this field.

stages.name: Process (Correlate & Adapt)
stages.operator_action: Explicit operator step. Run per-job or batch. Correlation JSON always overwritten. Letter JSON written only if absent.

stages.name: Browse & Print (UX)
stages.input: Correlation JSONs + letter JSONs in data/jobbankjobs/ + data/resume.source.json
stages.server: src/api/serve.py (Python stdlib). Exposes /api/years, /api/jobs, /api/resume, /api/correlation. /api/correlation merges correlation + letter JSON before responding, and includes metadata.candidate_name.
stages.html: src/api/resume-machine.html (vanilla ES2020). Year populated via /api/years. allJobs[] maintained as module-level array for client-side filtering. Loading indicator on job select.
stages.output: Operator print → PDF. document.title constructed from metadata.candidate_name + employer + job_title.

infrastructure.runtime: Python 3.10+ on macOS (primary). Single-threaded, no containerisation. Runs on operator's local machine only.

filesystem_layout.requirements.txt: Pip dependency manifest: beautifulsoup4, lxml, pyyaml. Install with: pip install -r requirements.txt
filesystem_layout.src/: Python package root. Contains src/__init__.py (empty, required for module imports).
filesystem_layout.src/data/py_skill_job_correlator.py: Correlation, adaptation, and cover letter generation.
filesystem_layout.src/api/: HTTP server and browser UX. Contains src/api/__init__.py.
filesystem_layout.src/api/serve.py: stdlib HTTP server. Four API endpoints.
filesystem_layout.config/config.yaml: candidate_name, jobbankjobs_dir, skills_index_path, resume_source_path, role_templates_dir, log_level.
filesystem_layout.data/jobbankjobs/: Source HTML and derived JSONs by {year}/{month:02d}/{day:02d}/.

ingest_workflow.description: Operator step 1. Parse HTML job postings and write one job JSON per file.

process_workflow.description: Operator step 2. Correlate, adapt, and write two output files. Correlation JSON always overwritten. Letter JSON written only if absent.
flags: --dry-run: print intended output paths without writing
--name <candidate>: override candidate name (slugified before use in paths)
process_workflow.output: resume-{candidate}-{employer}-{title}.json and letter-{candidate}-{employer}-{title}.json, co-located in the job's date directory.

ux_workflow.description: Operator launches local server, finds a job, reviews rendered output, prints to PDF.
steps: Page load: /api/years → year_select. /api/jobs?year=YYYY → allJobs[]. Year defaults to current year.
Keyword input: filter allJobs[] client-side. DOM re-rendered from filtered array. No server request.
Month change: /api/jobs?year=YYYY&month=MM → replace allJobs[]. Keyword filter reapplied.
Job select: show loading indicator. Fetch /api/correlation and cached /api/resume. Hydrate panels.
Cover letter toggle: show/hide cover_letter_section. No server request.
Print: document.title = slugified(candidate_name + employer + job_title). window.print().

control_layer._note: Configuration via config/config.yaml. Skills catalog via data/skills-index.json.

python_module_structure.description: All modules import each other directly. No subprocess calls between local modules.

adapter_wiring_specifics.function_signature: infer_domain(correlation_data: dict, role_templates_dir: str) → dict with keys: domain (str), featured_languages (list[str]), highlights (list[str], max 6)
adapter_wiring_specifics.template_loading: Templates loaded on first call per role_templates_dir and cached in a module-level dict (_template_cache: dict[str, list[dict]]). Cache valid for process lifetime — prevents 7N file reads for N-job batches. Cache invalidated only by process restart.
adapter_wiring_specifics.domain_scoring: Score each template by counting how many of its keywords appear as term values in correlation_data['correlations'][]. All tags count — domain inference reflects the job's vocabulary, not match quality. Higher score wins; ties broken alphabetically.
adapter_wiring_specifics.featured_languages_list: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, Java, Rust, C++, SQL, Bash, Ruby, PHP. Matched case-insensitively. SQL matched as exact token only — not as substring of SQL/MySQL or PostgreSQL.
adapter_wiring_specifics.output_merge: Returned dict merged into correlation_data before writing. Cover letter data written separately to the letter JSON — not merged here.

flags.--dir <dir>: Process all job JSONs in the given day-level directory. Does not recurse.
flags.--file <file>: Process a single job JSON. Mutually exclusive with --dir.
flags.--dry-run: Print intended output paths and skip writing.
flags.--name <candidate>: Override candidate name. Value is slugified before use in file paths.

cli_orchestrator_wiring.implementation: Calls correlate_job() as imported function — no subprocess. Writes correlation JSON (always) and letter JSON (if absent). Exits 0 on success, non-zero on any error.

ux_server_api.description: serve.py exposes four read-only GET endpoints plus static file serving. No authentication. No mutation endpoints. Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * on all /api/* responses.

endpoints.GET /api/years: Returns JSON array of year strings present as subdirectories under data/jobbankjobs/ (e.g. ['2024', '2025', '2026']), sorted descending. Used to populate the year <select>. Returns [] if data/jobbankjobs/ does not exist.
endpoints.GET /api/jobs?year=YYYY[&month=MM]: Returns JSON array: [{path, job_title, employer, location, domain}]. path is relative to project root and used as-is in /api/correlation requests. domain is read from each correlation JSON (O(N) file reads for N jobs). Sorted newest-first by directory date.
endpoints.GET /api/resume: Returns full content of data/resume.source.json. 404 if absent.
endpoints.GET /api/correlation?path=data/jobbankjo: Validates path is within data/jobbankjobs/ (path-traversal guard — HTTP 400 on violation). Reads correlation JSON. Derives companion letter path (replace 'resume-' prefix with 'letter-'). Merges letter fields if present. Includes metadata.candidate_name in the response for document.title construction. Returns correlation without cover letter fields if letter is absent.

ux_server_api.error_handling: All endpoints return 500 on file read or parse failure. Errors logged; generic 500 returned to client.

filters_panel.description: Non-printable. Hidden via @media print { display: none }.

controls.year_select: Populated from /api/years response on page load. Defaults to current year (or most recent year with data). Change triggers /api/jobs?year=YYYY fetch and replaces allJobs[].
controls.month_select: Blank by default. Selecting triggers /api/jobs?year=YYYY&month=MM fetch and replaces allJobs[]. Clearing returns to full-year view.
controls.keyword_search: Filters allJobs[] client-side by job_title and employer (case-insensitive substring). Re-renders DOM from filtered array. No server request. Active regardless of month state.
controls.cover_letter_toggle: Checkbox, checked by default. Toggles cover_letter_section visibility. No server request.

results_list.description: DOM list rendered from the current filtered view of allJobs[]. Each row: job_title, employer, date.
results_list.pre_selection_state: Printable area shows placeholder: 'Select a job to preview your resume.' No data is fetched.
results_list.loading_state: When a job row is clicked, show a loading indicator in the printable area while /api/correlation is in flight.
results_list.empty_state: If the filtered view of allJobs[] is empty, display: 'No results for current filters.'

data_sources.date: Current date 'Month DD, YYYY' — generated client-side
data_sources.cover_letter_fields: opening, value_proposition, relevant_experience[], closing — from /api/correlation response

resume_section.visibility: Visible once a job is selected.

data_flow.on_page_load: Fetch /api/years → populate year_select, default to current year. Fetch /api/jobs?year=YYYY → set allJobs[]. Render list. Show pre-selection placeholder in printable area.
data_flow.on_year_change: Fetch /api/jobs?year=YYYY → replace allJobs[]. Re-render list. Reapply keyword filter.
data_flow.on_month_change: If month set: fetch /api/jobs?year=YYYY&month=MM → replace allJobs[]. If cleared: fetch full year. Reapply keyword filter.
data_flow.on_keyword_input: Filter allJobs[] client-side. Re-render list from filtered array. No server request.
data_flow.on_job_select: Show loading indicator. Fetch /api/correlation?path=... and /api/resume (cache after first fetch). Hydrate panels. Hide loading indicator.
data_flow.on_cover_letter_toggle: Toggle cover_letter_section visibility. No server request.
data_flow.on_print: Construct filename: slugify(metadata.candidate_name) + '-' + slugify(metadata.employer) + '-' + slugify(metadata.job_title). Set document.title = filename. Call window.print().

print_requirements.fonts: Source Serif Pro for body text, Inter for UI controls

data_strategy._note: See data_schemas. File organization follows infrastructure.filesystem_layout.

operability._note: Operational commands belong in the README. See workflow_layer.

environments._note: Environment config belongs in config YAML files and the README.

items.description: summary.hard_gaps_count, summary.tag_distribution, and hard_gaps[] are derivable from correlations[] at read time. Stored redundantly for human readability. Risk: drift on manual edits.
facet_type_weights (hands_on_language: 1.0, etc.) are defined in skills_index_schema but not applied anywhere. Currently metadata-only.
options: Apply as a weighted_score float in summary alongside total_correlations.
